title: Runescape: Dragonwilds - How to cheese the Velgar Dragon fight
author: Seven Star Bricks
description:
Step One: Die after summoning Velgar. 
Step Two: Come back after death and use the summoning pylon as a platform to avoid most of his ground based attacks. (Still have to avoid the acid from the sky when he is flying, however.)
